resources.string: Mojiscope is running. Drag the box over Japanese text, then double-tap it.

The built-in dictionary is JMdict from February 2019. JMdict is updated almost every day, so a much newer copy exists. To update: download JMdict_english.zip from the link below, then import it here. Importing a dictionary with the same title as an installed one (ignoring a date in square brackets) replaces it. Mojiscope works offline and never downloads anything itself.

Mojiscope imports dictionaries in the Yomitan (formerly Yomichan) format: a .zip file that is not unpacked, containing index.json and term_bank_N.json files. Kanji dictionaries (kanji_bank_N.json) work too. Frequency and pitch-accent dictionaries have no definitions and are not supported.

Good sources are the dictionaries on the Yomitan wiki: Jitendex and JMdict (Japanese-English), JMnedict (names), KANJIDIC (kanji), and Japanese-to-other-language dictionaries such as Wiktionary and CC-CEDICT conversions.

Only one dictionary is used for word lookups at a time. Kanji information always comes from the built-in dictionary.

"Thanks for installing the beta version of Mojiscope! If you didn't intend to install the beta version, I highly recommend that you go to the Play Store and leave the beta program - the beta version of Mojiscope may be unstable and more prone to bugs. If you are not in the beta program and but still seeing this message, please let me know right away by e-mailing me below!
If you run into issues (i.e., constant crashes or graphical glitches) in the beta, please let me know at 0xbad1d3a5@gmail.com! Feedback and suggestions are also welcome!
BETA UPDATES:
vLATEST - Revert Tesseract library update as that was causing vertical OCR recognition issues - Fresh build from clone
v1.3.72 - Emergency fix for Android 12 - Update Tesseract libraries
v1.3.66 - Stop screen capture when device is put to sleep - Minor bugfixes
v1.3.62 - Updating beta version of Mojiscope will longer remove the icon from the home screen after this update - Improve artist text
v1.3.59 - Temporarily disable ads
v1.3.56 - Minor bugfixes - Added dialog in tutorial explaining Mojiscope's permissions
v1.3.55 - No Mojiscope updates, just backend changes - Bump Kotlin version, use Triple-T for automated Play Console uploads
v1.3.47 - Fix minor crashes in Mojiscope
v1.3.46 - Improve recognition of commonly mis-recognized kana such as ー or 一 - Improved normal mode so that the entire sentence can be copied, tap the sides of the normal mode window to scroll
v1.3.45 - Improve recognition of commonly mis-recognized kana such as く or し
v1.3.43 - Add similar kana to swap quick text action in case that OCR engine doesn't give that recommendation
v1.3.42 - Reduce size of tutorial videos
v1.3.40 - Revamped tutorial and shows on first start of the app - Fix minor bugs
v1.3.38 - Fixed entry ranking issue with dictionary - less common readings of a kanji will rank lower. - Fixed icon placement bug with select-to-swap actions in certain cases when the status bar / navigation bar is showing.
v1.3.37 - Removed history window. Not ready for prime time and I didn't particularly find it useful. - Added ability to completely hide Mojiscope's capture window through the notification.
v1.3.34 - Added history window. This window shows previous kanji that you have looked up. - You can now share text to Mojiscope to trigger the popup window as well.
v1.3.33 - One ad added to start screen. Sorry! But it's to help support development. It should be fairly out of the way, but let me know if it causes problems. - Adding the ad does get rid of the 'Close Capture Window' button, but a reminder to all that you can close Mojiscope by simply tapping on Mojiscope's notification in the status bar. If you are unable to close Mojiscope because the notification is missing, please send me an e-mail! - Fixed instant mode rotation bug where positioning was incorrect after device rotation. - Fixed bug where Mojiscope does not start on some devices (particularly Xiaomi devices).
v1.3.32 - Instant Mode window positioning logic has been implemented. If things look off here, please let me know!
Note that if you try to leave feedback on the Play Store as a beta user, it is not shown to all users."
